us_accidents_severity.Street: Name or number of the road or highway where the incident occurred
us_accidents_severity.Side: Side of the road (e.g., Right, Left) indicating the direction or lane
us_accidents_severity.City: City where the incident took place
us_accidents_severity.County: County administrative division of the incident location
us_accidents_severity.Zipcode: Postal code (ZIP code) of the incident area
us_accidents_severity.Sunrise_Sunset: Lighting condition indicating whether it was day or night at the time of the incident
us_accidents_severity.State: U.S. state where the incident occurred
us_accidents_severity.Nearby_Point_of_Interest: Type of nearby feature or landmark such as a junction, crossing, or traffic signal
us_accidents_severity.Year: Calendar year in which the incident happened
us_accidents_severity.Location: Full text description combining street, city, county, and state for geolocation reference

yelp.name: Business name of the establishment.
yelp.address: Street address of the business location.
yelp.city: City where the business is located.
yelp.state: Two-letter state abbreviation of the business.
yelp.postal_code: ZIP code of the business address.
yelp.latitude: Geographic latitude coordinate of the business.
yelp.longitude: Geographic longitude coordinate of the business.
yelp.review_count: Number of reviews received by the business (float).
yelp.is_open: Whether the business is currently open (string: 'open' or 'closed').
yelp.categories: Comma-separated list of business categories (e.g., type of cuisine or services).
yelp.price_range: Price level rating (1=cheap, 2=moderate, 3=expensive, 4=very expensive; NaN if unknown).
yelp.number_of_days_open: Number of days per week the business is open (float, e.g., 7.0 for every day).

spotify.artist: Name of the artist or band.
spotify.danceability: Measure (0 to 1) of how suitable a track is for dancing based on tempo, rhythm stability, beat strength, and overall regularity.
spotify.energy: Perceptual measure (0 to 1) of intensity and activity, including dynamic range, perceived loudness, timbre, onset rate, and general entropy.
spotify.key: Estimated overall key of the track (integer 0 to 11 mapped to pitch classes, e.g., 0=C, 1=C♯/D♭, etc., with -1 indicating no key detected).
spotify.loudness: Overall loudness of the track in decibels (dB), averaged across the entire track.
spotify.mode: Modality of the track (Major or Minor), indicating the type of scale from which its melodic content is derived.
spotify.speechiness: Measure (0 to 1) of the presence of spoken words; values above 0.66 suggest entirely spoken word, 0.33–0.66 suggest a mix, and below ~0.33 indicate music or non-speech content.
spotify.acousticness: Confidence measure (0 to 1) that the track is acoustic (non-electronic), based on timbral and spectral features.
spotify.instrumentalness: Predicts whether a track has no vocal content (0 to 1); values close to 1 indicate instrumental tracks.
spotify.liveness: Measure (0 to 1) of the presence of audience in the recording; higher values indicate a higher probability that the track was performed live.
spotify.valence: Measure (0 to 1) describing the musical positiveness conveyed by a track (e.g., happy, cheerful, euphoric vs. sad, depressed, angry).
spotify.tempo: Overall estimated tempo of a track in beats per minute (BPM).
spotify.duration_ms: Duration of the track in milliseconds.
spotify.time_signature: Estimated overall time signature (beats per bar, e.g., 3/4, 4/4), typically an integer from 1 to 7.
spotify.chorus_hit: Timestamp (in seconds) of the most prominent or defining chorus hit within the track.
spotify.sections: Number of distinct structural sections (e.g., verse, chorus, bridge) identified in the track.
spotify.decade: The decade of release (e.g., 60s, 70s, 80s) derived from the track's release year.
spotify.popularity: Target variable representing the popularity score or rank of the track (higher values indicate greater popularity).

zomato.name: Restaurant name
zomato.city: City or locality where the restaurant is located
zomato.rating_count: Number of customer ratings (e.g., "20+ ratings" indicates at least 20 ratings)
zomato.cost: Estimated cost for two people (in Indian Rupees)
zomato.cuisine: Types of cuisine offered by the restaurant (comma-separated)
zomato.link: URL to the restaurant's page on Swiggy
zomato.address: Full street address of the restaurant including area and state
zomato.target 'rating': Average customer rating (typically on a scale of 1 to 5)

nba_draft.year: The draft year in which the player was selected.
nba_draft.overall_pick: The overall selection number (1 to 60) of the player in that year's NBA draft.
nba_draft.team: The NBA team that drafted the player, represented by its three-letter abbreviation.
nba_draft.player: The full name of the drafted player.
nba_draft.college: The college or university the player attended prior to the draft; may be NaN if the player did not attend a U.S. college (e.g., international prospects).
nba_draft.years_active: The number of seasons the player was active in the NBA.
nba_draft.value_over_replacement: A cumulative statistic estimating the total number of wins the player contributed over a replacement-level player throughout their career.

roger_ebert.movie_name: The title of the movie, a unique identifier string.
roger_ebert.year: The release year of the movie, an integer representing the time period.
roger_ebert.directors: The name(s) of the director(s) responsible for the movie, a comma-separated string.
roger_ebert.actors: The name(s) of the main cast members, a comma-separated string (may be missing).
roger_ebert.genre: The genre classification(s) of the movie, a comma-separated string (e.g., Documentary, Romance).
roger_ebert.pg_rating: The MPAA or equivalent content rating (e.g., R, PG-13), a string (may be missing).
roger_ebert.duration: The runtime of the movie in minutes, a float.

ramen_ratings.Brand: The manufacturer or company name of the instant noodle product.
ramen_ratings.Variety: The specific flavor or product name of the instant noodle.
ramen_ratings.Style: The type of packaging (e.g., Cup, Box, Pack) for the product.
ramen_ratings.Country: The country of origin or where the product is sold/made.
ramen_ratings.Stars: The rating or score given to the product (target variable).

chocolate_bar_ratings.Company_(Manufacturer): Name of the chocolate manufacturer or brand.
chocolate_bar_ratings.Company_Location: Country or region where the manufacturer is based.
chocolate_bar_ratings.Review_Date: Year when the chocolate was reviewed.
chocolate_bar_ratings.Country_of_Bean_Origin: Country where the cocoa beans were grown.
chocolate_bar_ratings.Specific_Bean_Origin_or_Bar_Name: Specific geographical origin of the beans or name of the chocolate bar.
chocolate_bar_ratings.Cocoa_Percent: Percentage of cocoa content in the chocolate product.
chocolate_bar_ratings.Ingredients: List of ingredients used, often encoded with abbreviations (e.g., B for beans, S for sugar, C for cocoa butter).
chocolate_bar_ratings.Most_Memorable_Characteristics: Descriptive flavor notes or sensory characteristics of the chocolate.
chocolate_bar_ratings.Rating: Numerical score assigned to the chocolate based on its quality (target variable).

whisky.Whisky: Name of the whisky including brand, expression, and age statement or special edition.
whisky.Cost: Price range of the whisky in Canadian dollars (ranges from low to high).
whisky.Class: Broad stylistic category indicating resemblance to rye or single malt whiskies.
whisky.Cluster: Flavor profile description detailing body, sweetness, smokiness, and other tasting notes; may be missing (NaN).
whisky.Country: Country of origin where the whisky is produced.
whisky.Type: Type of whisky indicating whether it is a blend or a single malt.

coffee_ratings.roaster: The coffee roasting company or brand that produced the coffee.
coffee_ratings.name: The specific product name or designation of the coffee, often including origin, variety, or processing method.
coffee_ratings.location: The city and state where the roastery is based.
coffee_ratings.origin: The geographic region, district, or country where the coffee beans were grown, sometimes including specific growing areas or cooperatives.
coffee_ratings.roast: The roast degree or style applied to the coffee, indicating the level of roasting (e.g., Medium-Light).
coffee_ratings.desc_1: A detailed sensory description of the coffee's aroma, flavor notes, acidity, mouthfeel, and finish, typically written by a professional taster.
coffee_ratings.desc_2: Background information on the coffee's production, including variety, processing method, farmer or cooperative details, and sometimes additional context about the roaster.
coffee_ratings.desc_3: A concise summary or overall impression of the coffee, highlighting its key characteristics and appeal.

michelin.Name: Name of the restaurant, which may indicate brand reputation or chef association relevant to award likelihood.
michelin.Address: Full postal address of the restaurant, providing precise geographic location for context of prestige or regional awards.
michelin.Location: City and country of the restaurant, useful for identifying regional award patterns or culinary scenes.
michelin.Cuisine: Type or style of cuisine offered, often a key factor in award categories (e.g., traditional, creative, Chinese).
michelin.Longitude: Geographic coordinate for mapping restaurant location, potentially linked to award concentration in specific areas.
michelin.Latitude: Geographic coordinate complementing longitude for precise location analysis in award prediction.
michelin.Website_Url: Official website URL of the restaurant, presence or quality of which may correlate with award recognition or online reputation.
